scope: Synthetic retrieval engineering validation, not production or blind user quality acceptance
selection_rule: On development only, choose the lowest tested budget meeting pool thresholds and serial latency; evaluate frozen validation wording only after selection. Keep rerank and generation unchanged.
limitations: Validation questions were authored by the same assistant from the same source facts and frozen before measurements; they are new wording, not an independent blind benchmark. Templated distractors are a scale stress test. Raw filtering may change during concurrent revisions. Refusal, answer correctness and load performance are excluded.
